description: Keep coding across multiple accounts when one reaches its limit. Route Claude Code and Codex threads with quota-aware balancing, primary and reserve accounts, per-account caps, and session affinity. Connect Kimi, Z.AI, OpenCode Go, Cursor, and experimental Devin Local CLI; compatible external clients can use the proxy too. Bring your own provider accounts, subscriptions or API keys. Requires BB 0.43.1+ and Node/npm; disable BB's bundled Account Pooler because both register the same routes and command.
